Instead, "col canto" means the accompanist should wait for the singer's phrasing and variations, while "a piacere" allows the singer to express the melody and ornamentation flexibly, coordinating with the accompanist. It is recommended to adjust the tempo flexibly according to the phrasing and ornamentation needs rather than slowing down uniformly by a set amount. Coordination with the accompanist should be done through prior agreement to ensure flexibility and musicality.
